summary: Feed s136_double is degraded for NDR: 58.6% VXLAN-encapsulated traffic hides inner flows and 14.5% of frames are sliced to 256 bytes, preventing full-payload inspection.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is forwarding VXLAN-encapsulated traffic (1770/3018 frames) without stripping the overlay header. NDR is seeing outer VXLAN packets instead of inner original frames.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR cannot parse inner L2-L7 headers or payload, misses lateral movement and C2 detection, and wastes cycles on tunnel headers; 58.6% of traffic is effectively blind.

recommended_fix.why: Strip VXLAN at the packet broker to expose inner Ethernet/IP to the NDR for full detection coverage.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker slicing is enabled and cutting frames to ~256 bytes (437/3018 frames, 14.5% exceeds 5% threshold). Likely a broker slice policy left on for this NDR feed.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR requires full payload for deep packet inspection, file extraction, and signature matching. Truncated payloads cause missed detections and broken stream reassembly.

recommended_fix.why: Disable slicing for this NDR feed to deliver full payload as required by tool profile (needs_full_payload=true).
